With the league’s 65-game minimum rule in effect, stars like Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokic, and Luka Doncic are on the edge of eligibility. One more missed game could automatically disqualify them, regardless of their stats or impact. Meanwhile, Cade Cunningham could emerge as the biggest beneficiary, thanks to his durability and consistent performance.
